={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You are a resume parser for an Indian recruitment team. Extract structured data from each raw application below. Extract only what is stated. Never invent a skill, a salary or a company. You must NOT extract or infer age, gender, marital status, religion, caste or nationality, even if the text mentions them.

" + ($json.parse_blob || "none") + "

If the text above says none, return an empty applications array.
Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. One key applications holding an array, one entry per APPLICATION block. Each entry has keys: app_id, name, phone, current_role, current_company, years_exp, skills, education, current_ctc_lakh, expected_ctc_lakh, notice_days, location, summary, parse_confidence.
app_id must be copied exactly from the APPLICATION header line.
phone is the 10 digits prefixed with plus91.
years_exp, current_ctc_lakh, expected_ctc_lakh and notice_days are plain numbers. LPA and lakh mean the same thing. Use 0 if not stated.
skills is a single comma separated string of technologies only.
location is the city they are in now, or unknown.
summary is one factual sentence about their strongest relevant achievement.
parse_confidence is high, medium or low.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.1,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You are a technical recruiter at " + ($json.company_name || "the company") + " in India writing a job description. Be specific and honest. Never invent a benefit or a salary figure. Never reference age, gender, marital status, religion, caste, nationality, disability or appearance.

ROLE: " + ($json.title || "") + "
DEPARTMENT: " + ($json.department || "") + "
SENIORITY: " + ($json.seniority || "") + "
MUST HAVE SKILLS: " + ($json.must_have || "") + "
GOOD TO HAVE: " + ($json.good_to_have || "") + "
EXPERIENCE BAND: " + ($json.min_years || 0) + " to " + ($json.max_years || 0) + " years
LOCATION: " + ($json.location || "") + "
HIRING MANAGER NOTES: " + ($json.notes || "") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. Keys: headline, about_the_role, responsibilities, must_have_list, good_to_have_list, what_success_looks_like.
headline is one line that would make a good engineer stop scrolling. Do not use rockstar or ninja.
about_the_role is 2 to 3 sentences on what this person will actually work on.
responsibilities is an array of exactly 5 concrete responsibilities.
must_have_list and good_to_have_list are arrays of requirement lines.
what_success_looks_like is one line on what they will have achieved in six months.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.4,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You are a hiring panel lead preparing interview guidance. Never invent a fact about a candidate. You must never mention or infer age, gender, religion, caste, community, nationality, marital status, family situation, disability or appearance. Judge only demonstrated skills and experience.

ROLE: " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.title || "") + " at " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.company_name || "") + "
MUST HAVE: " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.must_have || "") + "
EXPERIENCE BAND: " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.min_years || 0) + " to " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.max_years || 0) + " years
BUDGET: " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.budget_ctc_lakh || 0) + " lakh
HIRING MANAGER NOTES: " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.notes || "") + "

SHORTLISTED CANDIDATES:
" + ($json.shortlist_lines || "none") + "

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. Keys: panel_headline, candidates.
panel_headline is one line summarising the strength of this shortlist.
candidates is an array with one entry per shortlisted candidate, keys: candidate_id, verdict, strength, risk, probe_questions.
candidate_id must be copied exactly.
verdict is one short line on why this person is worth an interview.
strength is the single strongest thing about them for this role.
risk is the single biggest thing to test, drawn only from their record.
probe_questions is an array of exactly 3 specific questions based on what their record says they have done.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.4,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}

={"contents":[{"parts":[{"text": {{ JSON.stringify("You write candidate emails for " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.company_name || "the company") + " in India. Warm, professional, plain Indian English. Never promise a salary, a start date or an outcome.

ROLE: " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.title || "") + "
LOCATION: " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.company_location || "") + "
RECRUITER: " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.recruiter_name || "") + "
INTERVIEW LENGTH: " + ($("Assemble Role Context").first().json.interview_minutes || 45) + " minutes

Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences. Keys: invite_subject, invite_lines, pool_subject, pool_lines, reject_subject, reject_lines.
invite_lines is an array of 4 short lines: congratulate them on clearing the screen, name the role and company, say a slot has been held and a calendar invitation is on its way, and ask them to reply if that time does not suit. Do NOT state the date or time, it is inserted separately.
pool_lines is an array of 3 short lines: thank them, say we shortlisted a small number for this role but their profile is strong, and say we will keep them in mind for upcoming openings.
reject_lines is an array of 3 short lines: thank them, say we are moving ahead with profiles closer to the requirement, and wish them well. Never explain what they lacked.
All three arrays exclude the greeting and sign off.
No em-dashes anywhere.") }} }]}],"generationConfig":{"temperature":0.5,"maxOutputTokens":8192,"responseMimeType":"application/json"}}
